messages:
olivia-support: Hi team — Marigold Labs just finished OIDC onboarding but their API key isn't showing in the console. Provisioner returned 200 and the invite completed. They can log in via SSO but calls get 401. Can someone look?
anna-cs: Thanks for flagging. Customer org: marigold-labs, project: ml-prod, user: eva@marigold.io. I can share logs/screenshots privately if needed.
provisioner-bot: [provisioner] claim.create -> success, claim_id=clm_01F7, service_account=svc-marigold-01, initial_state=PENDING_BIND
sam-identity: Pinging the identity team. Do we have the OIDC callback logs? Common issue: claim created but role-binding job failed.
jordan-eng: Looking. Can you paste the last 3 lines of the provisioner logs (the job that binds the project role)? Also include tenant_id returned by the OIDC provider.
olivia-support: Paste: 
```
2026-03-16T13:42:11Z INFO claim=clm_01F7 created
2026-03-16T13:42:14Z INFO binding-job started for claim=clm_01F7
2026-03-16T13:42:16Z ERROR binding-job claim=clm_01F7 failed: "role binding: project not found for tenant_id=''"
2026-03-16T13:42:20Z INFO claim=clm_01F7 status=FAILED
```
anna-cs: tenant_id blank — that's suspicious. The OIDC assertion should include tenant claim. Customer says their IdP sent group/tenant data.
sam-identity: If tenant_id is missing, our provisioner can't map to a project. Two likely causes: (1) IdP config missing the tenant claim mapping, or (2) the callback parser dropped the header.
mike-oncall: I can repro locally against the staging provisioner. Rapid check: does marigold-labs use encrypted tenant claim (nested JWT claim) or custom claim path? Customer said they used `org_id` in the IdP.
jordan-eng: We saw similar last month — the parser expects `tenant` or `tenant_id`. We do a fallback for `org_id` only in new version. What's the provisioner version in logs?
olivia-support: provisioner version: v3.2.1 (deployed 2026-03-10). Customer's SSO config screenshot: shows custom attribute `org_id` mapped to assertion.
jordan-eng: v3.2.1 doesn't fallback to org_id. That explains it. Two options: fast fix (manual bind the created service account to ml-prod) or upgrade provisioner -> v3.3.0 which includes `org_id` fallback.
anna-cs: Customer prefers no downtime. What's impact of manual bind? Are keys created automatically if we bind?
sam-identity: Manual bind will set the project_id on the claim and trigger key creation flow. It's safe. I can run the bind if eng approves. Steps: 1) validate claim clm_01F7, 2) run admin-bind --claim clm_01F7 --project ml-prod, 3) provisioner will retry and create key.
jordan-eng: Confirmed. I can run the admin-bind now in staging and then apply the same in prod. Will also create a quick guardrail in the parser to log when tenant claim fallback occurs.
olivia-support: Please proceed. Customer is blocked — they have seen 401s in prod traffic.
provisioner-bot: [admin-action] admin-bind executed by jordan-eng at 2026-03-16T14:01:02Z for claim=clm_01F7 -> BOUND
provisioner-bot: [provisioner] retry key-creation -> success, api_key=red_a1b2c3... (masked)
anna-cs: I handed the masked key to the customer via secure share. They confirmed API calls now return 200 and embeddings endpoints work.
mike-oncall: I'll open a follow-up to backport parser fix and add a monitor for missing tenant claim during binding. Ticket: INF-4521.
jordan-eng: I'll schedule v3.3.0 rollout this week and a config doc update for customer SSO mapping (note mapping for `org_id`).
olivia-support: Closing loop with Marigold. Thanks all :thumbsup:
